results.notes: Data: Toyota 439acd96 (the JDD brand analysis BA with a "D2 = 1 change / D1 = 2 changes" history does not exist on staging). Read-only: nothing ticked or saved; pool 804 / 1500 · 173 selected before and after. Step 3: one table, no tabs, no Reset button; headers PROMPT / CATEGORY / TYPE / COUNTRY / ACTIONS: the 4th column reads "Country", not "Market" (GEO-1514 wording), step PARTIAL (label only). Step 4: header menus "Sort and filter Category / Type / Country" + "Show prompts". Step 5: ring "804 / 1500 prompts · 173 selected", popover "Prompt pool 804 of 1500: In use by other analyses 631, Kept in this analysis 173, Free in the pool 696". Step 6: 174 rows; the only unticked suggestion ("What do you think of Toyota?", data-kept=false) is the last row, text greyed (#94a3b8), no "Suggested Prompts" heading. Step 7: "Add prompt" opens an inline draft row; the Type select lists Visibility, Reputation, Competitive, Brand Image, Other; closed with Escape + Cancel (nothing added). Steps 8-10: the "Prompts Version history" panel opens; changes grouped by date with their count (12 October 2026 · 32 Changes, 21 July 2026 · 5 Changes, 14 July 2026 · 2 Changes, 13 July 2026 · 22 Changes); the 21 July edit shows the original "What do you think of Toyota?" and the edited "lkkkkkk dzfkzfkkf ,fkza,flkéf,". The mechanism works, but the expected D2/D1 counts (1 and 2) and the 3 edited prompts are JDD-specific and cannot be checked on Toyota, so steps 9-10 PARTIAL.

results.notes: Toyota Action Center, Last 7 days, 4 engines, All Countries, 91 sources. Steps 2-3: tabs ALL / IMPROVE VISIBILITY (visibility icon) / IMPROVE PERCEPTION (thumb icon), ALL aria-selected with a 2px #0369A1 underline. Step 4: "Last 7 days", "AI Engines 4", "All Countries", export icon. Step 5: no category control in the global bar; page filters "All categories" (Filter by category) left of "All types". Steps 6-9: "#1 · guideautoweb.com", "Source 1 of 91", card #1 selected; Next source keeps the same <dialog> open: "#2 · largus.fr", "Source 2 of 91", card #2 selected, card #1 not. Steps 10-18 (source B = autobild.es, both reasons, 3 engines): "Lack of visibility (18)" (visibility_off icon, left, selected) and "Negative perception (3)" (thumb_down icon); "None of these articles mentions Toyota anywhere on the page."; engine filter between the heading and the first prompt; tabs "All (71)" (selected), then ChatGPT 58, Gemini 26, Perplexity 39 (icon + bare number, name in the title tooltip, e.g. "Gemini (26)"), fixed order, not by count. All (71) equals the card "Used in 71 prompts" (the 04/11 example was 86). Step 19: Sort by "Coverage" left of Card/List view; failing articles 27, 24, 24, 21, 21, 17, 13, 12... descending. Steps 20-22: "Prompts" gives 108, 107, 99, 94, 84, 77, 75, 73, 73, 71..., ranks 1-12 with no gap. Steps 23-25: #1 caranddriver.com "Used in 108 prompts", "Show 102 more prompts", All (108), 108 distinct rows. Steps 26-27: IMPROVE VISIBILITY and List view keep the "Prompts" order. Step 28: after reload "Coverage". Steps 29-33: IMPROVE PERCEPTION = 53 sources, all with the badge; Type Journalism (35) gives 35; 2nd card opens "#2 · yahoo.com" / "Source 2 of 35"; Next gives "#3 · largus.fr" / "Source 3 of 35". Steps 34-40: Category options All categories, Voitures hybrides, VUS = left menu, same order; Voitures hybrides gives 39 sources (<= 91), ranks 1-39, no card at 0.
